answer: Mechanism: per-identity delay crystals. Each agent grows a crystal - a verifiable-delay hash chain - one layer per epoch, anchored on-chain at a fixed ledge slot. Each layer embeds the epoch beacon and prior digest, so nothing is precomputable; new crystals first sit in a glacier, an m-epoch frozen escrow paying nothing, and a missed ledge resets growth. Attacker cost: n puppets need n sequential chains and n escrows thawing m epochs before earning - one core-epoch of delay time plus m epochs of dead capital per fake identity, so cost rises linearly with n.
